organization.name: POLSA, Polish Space Agency
organization.desc: National space agency under the Ministry of Development and Technology, coordinating space policy, ESA contributions and the national space program. Since 18 April 2026 its president also receives applications for space-activity permits and entries in the National Register of Space Objects under the Space Activity Act. Coordinated IGNIS, Poland's first government-sponsored astronaut mission, flown on Ax-4 (June 2025) with ESA project astronaut Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski.

proof.page_title: Ustawa o działalności kosmicznej - POLSA - Polska Agencja Kosmiczna
proof.evidence: Polish: the Space Activity Act entered into force 18.04.2026; from that date the President of POLSA accepts applications for space-activity permits and entries in the National Register of Space Objects (KROK).
proof.why_valid_on: POLSA's own official page; states a statutory role not in the baseline description. Re-opened by the VP on the run date; the 18.04.2026 text is on the page.

organization.name: CNES (Centre national d'études spatiales)
